description: This file defines an ApiClient class for handling HTTP requests with base URL management, token-based authentication, JSON serialization, and retry logic. It serves as a core network utility for the frontend of an attendance tracking application.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for making authenticated HTTP requests with retry logic, environment-based base URL, and token management.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL from environment variables, throwing if not set.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Saves a bearer token to persistent storage for use in authorization headers.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored bearer token, if any.

methods.name: _defaultHeaders
methods.description: Builds default request headers, including authorization if a token is available.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET with optional query parameters and retry logic.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST with JSON body and retry logic.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT with JSON body and retry logic.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE with optional JSON body and retry logic.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a full URI from base URL, path, and query parameters.

methods.name: _encodeBody
methods.description: Encodes the request body into JSON if necessary.

methods.name: _withRetry
methods.description: Retries a network request with exponential backoff on transient errors.

methods.name: parseJsonBody
methods.description: Decodes the response body from JSON.

methods.name: isSuccessStatus
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP status code indicates success.
